title: Kai Observation Adapter Metadata
description: Design-only metadata for read-only observation adapters; registration does not grant access.

adapter_id.description: Stable logical identity, not an executable or import path.

version.description: Adapter implementation version; three numeric components.

capabilities.description: Only capabilities expressible by Observation 1.0; environment support requires separate validation.

permissions.description: Explicit read-only declaration; does not enforce or grant operating-system permissions.

observation_schema_version.description: All collected observations must conform to observation.schema.json version 1.0.
